title: Canonical operations on arbitrary pro-etale ring-sheaf module objects
statement: For a scheme morphism f:T→X and a ring object B in abelian pro-etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], define module inverse image by mapMod of abelian inverse image [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], direct image by mapMod of direct image followed by restriction along the adjunction unit, and their adjunction by mapModAdjunction. For an open immersion j define extension by zero and its adjunction by mapModLeft and mapModLeftAdjunction of the existing abelian extension-by-zero adjunction [def-weil-extension-by-zero-presheaf]. For the cartesian square of g:X′→X and f:T→X [def-pc-fibre-product], let the square comparison be upperStarCompIso of pullback.condition, its coefficient map be its component at B, and square pullback be the module inverse image along the second projection followed by restriction of scalars through this coefficient map whenever it is multiplicative. These are the same eight transparent definitions previously in the parent module.
